pages.title: RG
pages.text: Release guard, then tap away - or down-away against a low - just before the hit. Nail it and you skip the usual time stuck after guarding (blockstun), plus the pushback, chip, and Guard Gauge gain. Hold guard too early and you just get a normal block. Miss the window and RG goes on a short cooldown, so don't try to mash it.

pages.title: RG Recovery
pages.text: After the freeze you land in RG recovery. No walking, jumping, dashing, or ordinary throws - but you CAN keep blocking or cancel straight into an attack. Character-specific command throws still work too.

pages.title: RG Cooldown
pages.text: On the ground you can't RG every single hit in a row. So in the final drill: RG the first hit, block the second normally to let the cooldown recover, then RG the low third hit.
